summary: Your site lists many treatments and insurers, but it sends patients in circles and shows little proof. These are the gaps I saw on the homepage.

findings.problem: Smile Gallery, every FAQ question and the opening hours link to #. Header says MOH approval, footer says DOH.
findings.cost: Patients who click for proof get nothing, and mixed regulator labels look careless on a medical site.
findings.fix: Working gallery, one correct approval number, FAQ that opens.

findings.problem: No booking form, only phone or WhatsApp. The WhatsApp link is written wa.me/+971..., which may not open.
findings.cost: Evening visitors who want to book online go to a clinic with a form.
findings.fix: Short booking form and a tested WhatsApp button on every page.

findings.problem: No patient reviews, no named dentists, no before and after. 'Our Doctors' is only a link.
findings.cost: Veneer and implant patients want faces and results before they call.
findings.fix: Doctor cards, Google reviews, captioned results.

findings.problem: Three sections repeat the same claims. Typos such as 'confidence.Whether' and 'Third molar removals,Tooth colored'.
findings.cost: Repeated copy buries your treatments and typos weaken trust.
findings.fix: One clean services layout with from prices.

redesign: A booking form and WhatsApp button on every page, with a stated reply time.
Doctor cards, real reviews and captioned before and after cases.
